background: Round-3 handoff listed 'MI 1800 still a lead'. The mi-wayback folder's Index to Bridge Detail Sheets named the PC special-detail sheets; current revisions and the BDG set were downloaded live from mdotjboss.state.mi.us with US VPN egress (Cloudflare blocks other IPs). Source PDFs mirrored to ~/Downloads/bridgebeams-manual/us/mi/.

MiMdotISection.validation: BDG 6.60.01 BEAM PROPERTIES: A/St/Sb/I all within 1% (Type I taper 3 1/4 in solved from printed properties; chain prints 4 of 5 segments)

MiMdot70ISection.validation: dimension chain closes exactly (6+2+1.5+49.5+3.5+7.5=70); no printed properties exist for this beam

MiMdot1800Section.validation: BDG 6.60.02: A -0.9%, St -0.7%, Sb +0.1%, I -0.3% with printed R7 7/8 and R2 fillets modelled; 4'-6 1/2 in chain member required for exact closure (glyph reads 4'-6 7/8 at 600 dpi)

MiMdotBulbTeeSection.validation: BDG 6.60.03 printed A/Ybot/Ixx reproduced to 0.1% at every depth; polygon-identical to round-3 MiBulbTeeSection (OR15-182 BTB 002), cross-checked in tests
